```python
    choices = ["rock", "paper", "scissors"]
    outcomes = {
        "rock": ["scissors", "wins"],
        "paper": ["rock", "wins"],
        "scissors": ["paper", "wins"]
    }

    # Generate a random choice for the computer
    computer_choice = random.choice(choices)

    # Determine the winner
    if user_choice in outcomes[computer_choice]:
        winner = user_choice
    else:
        winner = computer_choice

    # Print the result
    print(f"{user_choice} {outcomes[computer_choice][0]}s, you lose!")

# Play the game

```
